title: How to offer your element
description: How an element of your project becomes a starter in the Fractera marketplace.

body.text: An element you built and noticeably improved in your own project can become a starter for other projects.

items: You offer an element from your project.
Fractera checks it by hand and writes a check report.
The starter appears in the store on fractera.ai.
Half of every sale goes to the author.

body.text: The «Offer» button inside the project is still in progress. For now Fractera adds starters one at a time, each checked by hand.
